name: ImmDsForecast
title: ImmDS Forecast
description: Produces immunization forecast output from patient demographics, immunizations, observations, and a selected forecasting knowledge base using the proposed R6 HLN ImmDS operation. Output includes ImmunizationRecommendation and ImmunizationEvaluation resources with native coded series and season fields and an ICE-specific extension for series selection type.

parameter.name: assessmentDate
parameter.documentation: The date on which the immunization forecast should be assessed.

parameter.name: knowledgeBase
parameter.documentation: The forecasting knowledge base to execute, expressed as a canonical PlanDefinition identifier and version.

parameter.name: immunization
parameter.documentation: Immunization resources to be considered in the forecast.

parameter.name: scheduleFlag
parameter.documentation: Optional schedule flags expressed with valueCode.

parameter.name: data
parameter.documentation: Optional Bundle containing Patient, Immunization, and Observation input resources.

parameter.name: parameters
parameter.documentation: Optional implementation-specific tuning or execution parameters.

parameter.name: engineVersion
parameter.documentation: The CDS engine version that processed the request.

parameter.name: guidanceResponse
parameter.documentation: Summary metadata describing the execution and outcome of the forecast. In the ImmDS variant this resource does not expose the legacy module field.

parameter.name: evaluation
parameter.documentation: ImmunizationEvaluation resources produced by the forecast. series and optional season (0..1) are CodeableConcept values containing the selected series and season coding and text, emitted when series information is output for evaluations; optional seriesDoses (0..1) contains the number of doses in the selected series. extension may include url https://terminology.cdsframework.org/ice/StructureDefinition/immunization-selection-context with nested extension seriesSelectionType, or url https://terminology.cdsframework.org/ice/StructureDefinition/vaccine-group-rules-artifact containing a RelatedArtifact. targetDisease is a required array of one or more CodeableConcept values, with a separate concept for each disease. authority is an optional array (0..*) of Organization references populated from associated authority observations when outputScheduleAuthorities is enabled. Evaluation diseases are derived from the evaluated component CVX diseaseImmunity mapping in supportedVaccines.yml. MMR and DTP each contain three entries, while MR and DT each contain two; codings within a concept represent the same disease.

parameter.name: recommendation
parameter.documentation: ImmunizationRecommendation resources produced by the forecast. recommendation.series and optional recommendation.season (0..1) are CodeableConcept values. Optional recommendation.seriesDoses (0..1) is a CodeableConcept containing the number of doses in the selected series. Optional recommendation.seriesDosesRemaining (0..1) is a CodeableConcept containing only the remaining count, including zero when supplied. recommendation.extension may include url https://terminology.cdsframework.org/ice/StructureDefinition/immunization-selection-context with nested extension seriesSelectionType, or url https://terminology.cdsframework.org/ice/StructureDefinition/vaccine-group-rules-artifact containing a RelatedArtifact. When outputScheduleAuthorities is enabled, recommendation.authority is an optional array (0..*) of Organization references identifying the schedule authorities. Multiple distinct authorities share one recommendation backbone entry.

parameter.name: operationOutcome
parameter.documentation: Warnings, informational notes, or errors related to processing.
